_doc: MOCAP strand pose table: action -> keys (in order) -> view -> pose. Poses are rig_lib.pose() keys (per-bone Euler deg in armature axes, Q = D_parent^-1 D_child; upper_arm Y pre-compensated for the +12 ABD), retargeted from real motion capture (v2/mocap/scripts/retarget.py + actions.py) with a light per-view camera layer, plus forearm.* (elbow; needs ELBOW=1 rig), off [x,y] root offset, absz/lift for air keys, katana 1. Render: v2/mocap/scripts/pt.py (MOCAP=1 ELBOW=1 via rj.sh). W/SW/NW = mirrored E/SE/NE.
rig: v2/hy3d/rigs/E/parts (copy v2/pose/rig/parts_E) posed by v2/mocap/scripts/rig_lib.py (arms split at the elbow)
camera: ortho, 30 deg elevation, 48 px figure, 64x64 cell

idle.note: Bandai guard (chudan) settling 126->162 ping-ponged, real micro-motion x4 about guard frame 162, stance +0.07 L per foot

walk.note: Bandai1 walk_active cycle 58-90; contact/down/pass keys at gait events; swing x1.25 about the cycle mean

run.note: CMU 09_01 cycle 43-131 (0.73 s real -> 440 ms); swing x1.3 about the cycle mean, +12 deg lean, flight x1.6

jump.note: CMU 16_03 high jump; crouch/air/land pushed x1.35 (apex tuck x1.6) about standing frame 100; height x1.8

dash.note: CMU 143_03 start-to-run (antic/drive) + CMU 127_05 run-to-quick-stop (skid/rise); drive pushed x1.4 + 14 deg lean

slash.note: Bandai slash_normal_002 rising diagonal cut; windup..follow pushed x1.3 about the guard frame 20; zanshin hold 66-90 cut

overhead.note: Bandai slash_normal_001 two-handed vertical cut; raise x1.4, impact x1.3 (drop x2) about guard frame 160

hurt.note: LaFAN1 pushAndStumble1_subject5 pushed from the front (NC-ND reference); reaction x1.5 about pre-hit frame 545
